modules.description: List of notification modules to configure. Each entry must specify 'name' (Banner|Popup|Command|LCD|SysTrayicon|Indicator). All other fields are optional and module-specific defaults apply if omitted. Each module type has its own subset of allowed keys — only those for the selected module will be rendered if present in the entry. This is required to enable at least one module, otherwise config is empty and no notifications run. See NOTES in man page: Gmail and other IMAP servers without \Recent flag cause unreliable notifications for 'Popup' and 'Banner'. Command execution may require shell quoting in 'command' value; do not escape here — do so in 'command' string if needed. LCD requires LCDd server to be running and accessible; SysTrayicon uses libappindicator if available (GNOME, KDE). Indicator module only appears in desktops with AppIndicator support (GNOME with extension, KDE via kdeplasma-applets-appindicator, etc.).
